blurb: Thames View Marina is home to 94 boat slips with power and water. Both Summer dockage and Winter berthing are available as well as Winter dry storage (must be trailered). The marina has a fully functioning office and is open year-round. The office also services all equipment rental, such as kayaks, tables, tents, chairs, canopy tents, coolers, lawn games,
